## Importing packages and establishing file paths

```{r}
library(readr)
library(abcdutils)
library(here)
library(metasnf)
library(rlist)

input_path <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/inputs")))
proc_path <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/results/processed")))
fig_path <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/results/figures")))

source("abcd/functions.R")
```

```{r}
mtbi_io_esm <- read_csv(proc_path("2024_02_28_mtbi_io_esm.csv"))
mtbi_ari <- read_csv(proc_path("2024_02_15_aris_all_mtbi_imputations.csv"))
mtbi_ari_order <- read_csv(proc_path("2024_02_28_mtbi_ari_order.csv"))
mtbi_split_vec <- c(233, 350, 500, 723, 830, 1404, 1685, 1900)

mtbi_nd_io_esm <- read_csv(proc_path("2024_02_27_mtbi_nd_io_esm.csv"))

cmu_nd_ari_order <- read_csv(proc_path( "2024_02_25_aris_all_cmu_imputations_order_no_demo.csv"))

# MTBI
representative_mc(
    split_vector = mtbi_split_vec,
    aris = mtbi_ari,
    ari_order = mtbi_ari_order,
    solutions_matrix = mtbi_io_esm,
    group_name = "mtbi",
    possible_data = list(
        "m1" = c(data_list_m1, oom_list_m1),
```
